title: Agent Gym: A Framework for Continuous Evaluation and Evolution of LLM Agents Through Human-in-the-Loop Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2608.15591v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents deployed in production environments face a fundamental tension: the agent's behavior is frozen at deployment time, while the business rules and edge cases it must handle continue to evolve. Existing approaches address agent construction and one-time evaluation but provide no structured mechanism for continuous post-deployment behavioral correction without modifying the agent's source code. Most of the approaches offered in the market, require intense collection of logs and traces, and re-examining the agent design by the engineering team, a process which is heavy, long and negates the economical value of agentic transformation. translated_title: Agent Gym：一种通过人在环反馈实现LLM智能体持续评估与演化的框架
translated_abstract: 大规模语言模型（LLM）智能体在生产环境中的部署面临一个根本性矛盾：智能体在部署时行为被冻结，而它必须处理的业务规则和边缘情况却在持续变化。现有方法侧重于智能体的构建和一次性评估，但缺乏一种结构化的机制，能在不修改智能体源代码的情况下，对部署后的行为进行持续修正。市场上大多数方法需要大量收集日志和追踪信息，并由工程团队重新审查智能体设计，这一过程繁琐且耗时，削弱了智能体转型的经济价值。我们提出了Agent Gym，一个模块化、领域无关的框架，可将任何现有的基于LLM的智能体封装在一个持续的评估与演化循环中。该框架提供六种可组合的能力——执行（Act）、评估（Evaluate）、调查（Investigate）、纠正（Correct）、学习（Learn）和观察（Observe）——并组织在多个层面。
tldr: Agent Gym提出了一种模块化、领域无关的框架，通过人在环反馈实现LLM智能体部署后的持续评估与演化，无需修改源代码即可进行行为修正。
en_tdlr: Agent Gym introduces a modular, domain-agnostic framework that enables continuous evaluation and evolution of LLM agents post-deployment through human-in-the-loop feedback, without modifying source code.
